english.title: Participated in an unauthorised trial between motor vehicles on a footpath / bridleway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) took part in a trial between motor vehicles on a

(A)_[footpath]_
(B)_[bridleway ]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) when the holding of the said trial had not been authorised by the local authority under section 33 of the Road Traffic Act 1988.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(3)(a) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) In the Statement of Facts state the capacity in which the defendant took part in the trial or give details of the nature of the promotion and give details of the number and type of vehicles involved, speeds attained and potential danger to members of the public.
(iii) See also offence wording: H3047.
